title: Give to Markaz Al Azeem
intro: Give by bank transfer. There is no card charge on this page. You send the money from your own bank, tell the office, and we email a private link once the credit is confirmed.
label: Give
causeUnavailable: This cause is unavailable for the selected purpose. Choose another cause or give to all needs.
zakatNote: Only causes approved for Zakat appear with this purpose.
transferNote: Check the account title and number in your banking app before making a transfer. Contact the institute office for help directing your gift.
noAccounts: The institute has yet to publish bank transfer details. Please visit the office for current giving instructions.
noMatchingAccounts: The institute has yet to publish bank details for this purpose. Please visit the office for guidance.
copyError: Select and copy the value manually.
amountHelp: Enter the amount in rupees, using numbers only.
amountInvalid: Please enter the amount in rupees, using numbers only.
recurringLater: Automatic monthly and yearly gifts need card payments, which are not available yet. You can set up a standing order at your bank and tell the office.
bankTransferHelp: This is the way to give today. Write the amount in the transfer description, then tell the office so it can be recorded.
onlineLater: Online payment is not set up yet. Please use a bank transfer.
tellOffice: Tell the office about your transfer
sampleAccounts: These bank details are sample data. They are not an account you can transfer to. The madrasa will publish the real account from its settings.
reassureAccount: Match the account title in your banking app before you send anything. A row marked as sample is not for transfer.
reassureEmail: Your email is enough. We use it to confirm the gift and to send the private trail link.
reassureTrail: Zakat stays with causes marked for Zakat. When spending is recorded, the oldest gifts in that cause are matched first.
